name: FRDM-MCXN947
description: $25 FRDM board for the dual-core Cortex-M33 MCX N947 with eIQ NPU: MCU-Link debugger, Ethernet, USB-C, CAN-FD transceiver and Arduino, FRDM, Pmod and mikroBUS headers.
notes: Dual Cortex-M33 at 150 MHz with up to 2 MB dual-bank flash. NXP lists extra FlexIO/LCD and SmartDMA/camera headers; the microSD slot comes from Zephyr docs and was not on the NXP page.
NXP's page showed 'Pending Stock'/backorder in late 2026; DigiKey and Arrow had stock. Board size and GPIO count are approximate.
